qa.question: Should Maddox Unit 2 planned retirement move from 2034 to 2043?
qa.finding: GEM shows 2034, taken from the EIA table. SPS 2026 plan Table 3-1 lists Maddox Unit 2 at 62 MW with an expected retirement date of 2043. The 2023 plan said the unit would be extended three years from 2025 to 2028.
qa.recommendation: Change Planned retire on unit 2 to 2043 as a new scheduled retirement event, after the reviewer opens the commission filing and confirms the table.
qa.note: Open case 25-00076-UT at https://e360.prc.nm.gov/portal/public/#/public/nm-prc/en/CaseXscreen?screen=external-Case360&caseId=fe3141c2-1770-4ee1-90a7-f9c3a4749200, filing DOC-000532299-26, PDF page 47, Table 3-1, under Grid Balancing Resources, Gas, the row "Maddox Unit 2, Lea Co., NM, 62, 2043". The 2023 plan at https://www.xcelenergy.com/staticfiles/xe-responsive/Company/Rates%20&%20Regulations/Resource%20Plans/2023%20SPS-IRP%20Plan.pdf says "3-year extension of Maddox Unit 2 from 2025 to 2028". The EIA table at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx still shows December 2034. The portal could not be read by the verifier, so no value is proposed. In the second pass I opened the Xcel Energy page for the New Mexico 2027 to 2046 plan at https://www.xcelenergy.com/company/rates_and_regulations/resource_plans/new_mexico_2027-2046_irp. Its link to the plan document, https://xcelnew.my.salesforce.com/sfc/p/1U0000011ttV/a/R300000YZWcY/_fFYXD6bn_rleQjhaRJ9XZ_GHjexUzC57fARqr3lTDc, did not load any text that names Maddox, so it could not be cited. A web search and the PRC news release found no readable copy of the table either. The saved case copy shows the same table. The Texas filing that confirms the Maddox Unit 1 extension, docket 58664 (Eric Tucker's direct testimony at https://interchange.puc.texas.gov/Documents/58664_13_1542660.PDF), covers only unit 1, so it does not settle unit 2.

qa.question: Should Maddox Unit 3, an 11.5 MW gas turbine, be added?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists a third generator at Maddox plant 2446. It is an 11.5 MW natural gas combustion turbine operating since 1963 with planned retirement December 2034. The database has only units 1 and 2.
qa.recommendation: Add Maddox Unit 3 as an operating gas turbine of 11.5 MW with start year 1963 and planned retire 2034, since it sits at a plant already in the tracker.
